name: Devil
overview: Scripture reveals the devil as a real and active spiritual adversary who deceives the world and opposes God's truth, described as a liar and murderer from the beginning (John 8:44; Revelation 12:9). Believers are called to resist his schemes by submitting to God and standing firm in the armor of God (James 4:7; Ephesians 6:11). The devil's intent is to steal, kill, and destroy, but Christ came to give abundant life, highlighting the stark contrast between the devil’s destructive nature and Christ’s redemptive mission (John 10:10). Ultimately, the devil’s time is limited, yet his wrath is fierce, emphasizing the urgency of spiritual vigilance (Revelation 12:12).
